app.subtitle: UFW Remote Manager
app.metadataDescription: Self-hosted remote UFW management over SSH

setup.title: Initial Setup
setup.description: Create the first administrator account for UFW Remote Manager.
setup.name: Name

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Manage remote Linux servers and their UFW rules.
servers.configExportWarning: The file will contain SSH credentials in plain text. Store it securely.
servers.configExportDescription: Re-enter your password to download a configuration file with SSH credentials in plain text.
servers.configImportDescription: Servers missing from the file will be deleted along with all their rules and snapshots.
servers.rulesUnavailable: Rules editing becomes available after UFW is installed and active.

new.title: Add Server
new.description: Choose a saved SSH identity. Connection is verified before save.
new.detailsDescription: Host, port, and SSH identity are required.

edit.title: Edit Server
edit.detailsDescription: Changing host or identity requires a successful SSH test.
edit.hostKeyUnverified: Host key imported from configuration — run SSH test to verify

delete.title: Delete server?
delete.description: Server "{name}" and all of its local data will be permanently removed: confirmed rules, drafts, snapshots, and apply sessions. Remote UFW on the server is not changed.
delete.dangerDescription: Deleting a server removes all related records from the local database.

serverForm.name: Name
serverForm.noIdentities: Create an SSH identity before adding a server.

identities.title: SSH Identities
identities.description: Reusable SSH credentials for connecting to servers. Secrets are encrypted locally.
identities.empty: No SSH identities yet. Create one to use when adding servers.

new.title: Add SSH Identity
new.detailsDescription: All fields are required based on the selected auth method.

edit.title: Edit SSH Identity
edit.linkedServersDescription: Servers added to the system that connect with this SSH identity.
edit.linkedServersEmpty: This identity is not used by any server yet.

delete.title: Delete identity?
delete.blockedDescription: This identity is used by {count} server(s). Reassign or delete those servers first.
delete.dangerDescription: Deleting an unused identity removes its encrypted credentials from the local database.

identityForm.name: Name
identityForm.credentialsSavedDescription: For security, passwords and private keys are never shown again after saving. They remain encrypted in the local database and are used when connecting to servers. Empty fields below do not mean data was lost — leave them blank to keep the current secret, or enter a new value to replace it.
identityForm.secretFieldEditHint: Empty = keep the saved value. Fill in only if you want to change it.
identityForm.passwordPlaceholderEdit: Saved password is hidden — leave empty to keep it
identityForm.privateKeyPlaceholderEdit: Saved private key is hidden — leave empty to keep it
identityForm.passphrasePlaceholderEdit: Saved passphrase is hidden — leave empty to keep it
identityForm.updateWarningDescription: This identity is used by {count} server(s). Saving will change SSH access for all of them.

ufw.installDescription: UFW will be installed and activated on the remote server via SSH.

toolbar.hint: Unsaved table edits are discarded when you refresh status. Save to the local database and remote UFW only via <highlight>Save Rules</highlight> with confirmation.

applyDialog.title: Confirm UFW rule changes
applyDialog.description: Rules from the table will be saved to the local database and applied to the remote firewall when needed. Review the plan below before confirming.
applyDialog.partialResync: Some rules were applied before the error. Use Force resync to align local state with UFW.

table.legendRemoteOnly: Present on UFW, not in local DB
table.legendMatched: Present on UFW and in local DB
table.legendLocalOnly: Not on UFW, present in local DB
table.clearFiltersToReorder: Clear search and column filters to reorder rules

operationsPage.title: Operations History
operationsPage.description: Recent operation logs and audit events across all servers.
operationsPage.clearHistoryDescription: All operation logs and audit events will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
operationsPage.clearHistoryBlocked: Cannot clear history while an operation is running.

messages.apply_complete: Done: all rule changes applied successfully
messages.enable_complete: Done: UFW enabled and rules synced
